name: Dagger of Venom

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Coat in Poison
powers.text: Magic action: thick black poison coats the blade for 1 minute or until you hit (once per dawn).

summary: +1 dagger; once a day, poison it: the next creature hit makes a DC 15 Con save or takes 2d10 Poison and is Poisoned.
text: This magic dagger grants +1 to attack and damage rolls. Once per dawn, a Magic action coats its blade with thick black venom that lasts 1 minute or until the dagger hits a creature. The creature it hits must pass a Constitution saving throw (DC 15) or suffer 2d10 Poison damage and be Poisoned for 1 minute.
